backend/servers/reality-server/src/services/saved_search_alerts.rs:197-240 run_once advances each saved search's watermark unconditionally after a capped scan (match_limit default 100). SQL (crates/db/src/repositories/reality_portal/searches.rs:68-104) is ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT $13.

mark_saved_search_matched (:237-240) sets last_matched_at = now() UNCONDITIONALLY (searches.rs:134-159). Consequence: if >100 listings match a saved search within one cadence window (plausible after bulk portal imports), the newest 100 are returned and the rest are permanently dropped — watermark leaps to now(), next run resumes from published_at > now(). Dropped rows are precisely the OLDEST matches.

Silent data loss under exactly the high-volume conditions where alerts matter most. Fix options: advance watermark to MIN published_at minus epsilon (resume-from-oldest); or loop page-by-page until fewer than match_limit rows; or at minimum tracing::warn when ids.len() == match_limit.
